paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of ChatGPT under different relation popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The provided line chart, titled “ChatGPT on Songs,” illustrates the relationship between “Answer Popularity” (on the x-axis) and three performance metrics — “Accuracy,” “Confidence,” and “Alignment” (on the y-axis) — for ChatGPT under varying levels of popularity. The chart uses three distinct colored lines with different marker styles to represent each metric.

The x-axis is labeled “Answer Popularity” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160. The tick labels are positioned at regular intervals of 20 (i.e., at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, and 160), with no units specified. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The tick labels are positioned at intervals of 0.2 (i.e., at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0), with no units specified.

The blue line with circular markers represents “Accuracy.” It begins at approximately 0.55 when Answer Popularity is 0, dips to its lowest point of approximately 0.48 at Answer Popularity 20, rises to approximately 0.78 at Answer Popularity 40, fluctuates slightly between approximately 0.78 and 0.82 until Answer Popularity 80, then declines to approximately 0.80 at Answer Popularity 100 before stabilizing near 0.82 for the remainder of the range.

The green line with triangle markers represents “Confidence.” It starts at approximately 0.92 when Answer Popularity is 0, exhibits a slight overall upward trend, reaching a peak of approximately 0.98 at Answer Popularity 100, and then gradually declines to approximately 0.96 at Answer Popularity 160.

The red line with square markers represents “Alignment.” It begins at approximately 0.63 when Answer Popularity is 0, dips to approximately 0.58 at Answer Popularity 20, rises to approximately 0.82 at Answer Popularity 40, remains relatively stable near 0.85 until Answer Popularity 100, then gradually declines to approximately 0.87 at Answer Popularity 160.
